# Sham Tours Travel & Umrah Platform Specification (llms-full.txt)

> Official Agentic Documentation for Sham Tours Travel & Umrah Booking Services.

## Executive Overview

Sham Tours (شركة شام تورز للسياحة برامج العمرة) is a leading Egyptian travel agency specializing in custom Umrah packages, August & September spiritual pilgrimages, luxury hotel bookings in Makkah & Madinah, flight reservations, and tourist visa processing.

- **Official Website**: https://shamtours.am8ed.site
- **Parent Entity**: Amged Sayed Digital Ecosystem (https://am8ed.site)
- **Primary Contact**: Direct WhatsApp Desk (+201000000000) & Contact Form
- **Headquarters**: Cairo, Egypt

## Featured Travel & Pilgrimage Services

### 1. August & September Umrah Packages (برامج عمرة أغسطس وسبتمبر)
- Custom Umrah package planning with flexible duration options (10, 14, or 21 days).
- Direct flights with EgyptAir & Saudia Airlines from Cairo International Airport (CAI) to Jeddah (JED) or Madinah (MED).
- 5-Star and 4-Star hotel accommodations within walking distance to Al-Masjid an-Nabawi and Al-Masjid al-Haram in Makkah.
- Dedicated spiritual guides, religious supervisors, and air-conditioned VIP bus transfers between cities.

### 2. Custom Trip Planner (تخصيص برامج السياحة والرحلات)
- Tailored holiday itineraries across Egypt, Saudi Arabia, and international destinations.
- Group rates, family discounts, and VIP transport reservations.

### 3. Tourist & Pilgrimage Visa Application (استخراج التأشيرات)
- Express Saudi electronic tourist visa (e-Visa) & Umrah visa processing.
- Passport validation, insurance issuance, and document verification.

## Technology Stack

- **Frontend**: React 19, Vite 8, TailwindCSS v4, Framer Motion
- **Analytics & Conversion**: Google Tag Manager (`GTM-MD587CKT`), Google Ads Conversion Actions (`AW-18384004639`)
- **API Architecture**: REST APIs, JSON-LD Structured Data (`TravelAgency` & `TourReservation`)
